description: Bring a file from this computer into the open scene, as dropping it on the canvas does: a picture or video becomes a layer (or fills the layer `target`, by id — a card, a phone screen, a component's slot), sound a clip at the playhead, a GLB/glTF/splat a model, a .lottie or Lottie .json an animation, an SVG a vector, a TTF/OTF/WOFF a font of the scene's. Answers with what happened and the layers it added.
name: import_file
